about.summary: Senior Software Architect with over 15 years of expertise in designing and delivering high-scale enterprise e-commerce platforms, particularly within the SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) ecosystem. Expert in cloud-native microservices architecture using Java, Spring Boot, AWS, and Kafka. A pioneer in AI-driven development, integrating generative AI agents like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot to optimize engineering workflows. Proven track record of leading architectural vision, technical solutioning, and mentoring high-performing, distributed engineering teams for global clients like Amway, Tata CLiQ, and Changi Airport Group.

experience.description: Leading architecture and delivery across critical commerce modules (Cart, Checkout, POS, Payments, OMS). Designing cloud‑native microservices using Java, Spring, AWS, and Kafka. Integrated API gateways, observability tools, and generative AI chat platforms. Mentorship and upskilling teams.

Solutioned and architected Marketplace commerce implementations using SAP Hybris OCC. Integrated with Kafka, Elastic, CRM, and payment providers. Handled end-to-end commerce flows from PDP to Returns/Refunds.

Designed and built a New Generation Marketplace platform for a major Singapore Airport Group. Integrated SAP Commerce Cloud with Mirakl, Fluent, and Adobe AEM. Led multiple project modules and customized promotions/payments.
Developed B2C SAP Commerce sites for fashion brands in Japan. Integrated Hybris with Adobe AEM and handled complex checkout customizations for Apparel and Furniture.
Architected SAP Hybris migrations and provided support for B2B sites. Worked on CMS, Backoffice, and OMS implementations for healthcare and telecom clients.

coverLetter.subject: Application for Senior Software Architect Position
bodyParagraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Software Architect position. With over 15 years of experience in architecting, developing, and deploying high-performance enterprise e-commerce applications, I am confident in my ability to drive technical excellence and innovation within your organization.

In my current role as a Senior Software Architect at Nagarro, I have led the end-to-end delivery of complex commerce modules for global leaders like Amway. My expertise lies in designing scalable, cloud-native microservices using Java, Spring Cloud, and AWS, and seamlessly integrating them with platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris). Recently, I have spearheaded the adoption of Generative AI tools (Claude Code, Amazon Q Developer) into our development lifecycle, significantly accelerating time-to-market while maintaining architectural integrity.

I am passionate about building resilient systems and cultivating a culture of technical mentorship. My deep background in e-commerce—from Cart and Checkout to OMS and complex integrations—complements my commitment to clean architecture and modern DevOps practices. I thrive in leading distributed teams through the challenges of digital transformation and high-scale migrations.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my resume and look forward to discussing how my technical leadership and deep architectural background align with your company's strategic goals.
